sloka: स ताभ्यां सहसोत्पत्य विष्ठितो विमले ऽम्बरे ।मुद्गराभ्यां महाबाहुर्वक्षस्यभिहतः कपिः ।। ५.४६.२८।।।।
transliteration: sa tābhyāṁ sahasotpatya viṣṭhito vimale 'mbare ।mudgarābhyāṁ mahābāhurvakṣasyabhihataḥ kapiḥ ।। 5.46.28।।।।

translations.english: As the strongarmed vanara stood stationed in the clear white sky both the generals leaped into the sky and hit him all of a sudden with two iron hammers.
